user.title: Add room
user.description: Configure the basic settings for this room.

data_description.name: A unique name for this room (e.g. Living Room).
data_description.trv_entity: The climate entity of the TRV to control.
data_description.temp_sensor: An external temperature sensor for accurate readings.

options.title: Room options
options.description: Configure optional settings for this room.

data_description.window_sensors: Binary sensors that detect open windows. Heating is turned off when any sensor reports open.
data_description.cv_switch: Switch that controls the boiler. Turned on when heat is needed, turned off only when no room needs heat.
data_description.calibration_mode: How to compensate for TRV temperature inaccuracy.
data_description.target_temperature: The desired room temperature (used in target_temp calibration mode).
data_description.check_interval: How often to check sensors and calibrate (in seconds).
data_description.notification_service: Service to call for notifications (e.g. persistent_notification.create).

error.already_configured: A room with this name is already configured.
